_comment: Entity-identifier verification breakpoint set. See docs/debug_verification_guide.md section 5 for what to inspect at each stop. Import with: python tools/breakpoint_bridge.py import-pycharm --bridge .debug/breakpoints.entity-verification.json  (close PyCharm first).

breakpoints._why: run_experiment entry - inspect full config (identifier_mode, train_epochs, seed)
build_dataset - swiss returns ConcatDataset, others a single Dataset
auto_detect_enc_in - must equal C_base + D for transparent modes
make_entity_features - data-layer bake-in of transparent identity
EntityTransparentWrapper.forward - x_enc last dim C_base -> C_base+D, 0 learnable params
EntityWrapper.forward - embedding lookup then projection BACK to C_base
loss.backward() - confirm loss is finite and actually backpropagates
optimizer.step() - CRITICAL anti-fake-run check: compare a parameter before/after, it MUST change
evaluate - metrics dict must be finite and match the committed table value
